user.title: JNS Deployment Platform
user.description: Install the JNS deployment service. No shared SFTP password is required. After setup, open Configure and create a one-time code to enrol each management PC.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one JNS Deployment Platform instance is supported.
abort.supervisor_required: JNS management-PC enrolment requires Home Assistant OS/Supervisor.

enroll_pc.title: Enrol a new management PC
enroll_pc.description: Create a single-use enrolment capability for a management PC. Continue only while you are physically/administratively approving a new JNS workstation.

enrollment_code.title: Management-PC enrolment code
enrollment_code.description:
Enter this code in the new JNS Windows console: {enrollment_code}

It expires in about {ttl_minutes} minutes and can be used once. Only public SSH/signing keys are sent to Home Assistant.

management_pcs.title: Manage JNS management PCs
management_pcs.description:
Enrolled PCs: {pc_summary}

Legacy SFTP keys: {legacy_key_count}; legacy publisher present: {legacy_publisher}. Legacy credentials cannot be removed until an enrolled PC has completed commissioning.

legacy_transport.title: Legacy transport recovery
legacy_transport.description:
Recovery-only compatibility for pre-v5.5 installations. Normal v5.5 operation uses per-PC SSH keys and no shared SFTP password.

Last provisioning result: {provision_error}

error.invalid_password: Use a password of at least 24 characters without line breaks.
error.cannot_provision_sftp: JNS Secure SFTP provisioning failed. The exact stage and Supervisor error are shown above.
error.management_action_failed: The management-PC action could not be completed. Check Home Assistant logs and commissioning state.
